name: Karchive
subtitle: Somesh Kar's experiments, as apps you can install
description: Apps from Somesh Kar's experiments: systems, voice, agents and whatever else needed an iPhone or iPad to try out. Built on his own machines, unsigned; SideStore or LiveContainer signs them on your device. Expect rough edges, and new builds often.

apps.name: Scan3D
apps.subtitle: Scan objects to print them at true size
apps.localizedDescription: Two capture modes. Orbit: move around the object like you're filming and the app keeps a sharp 4K frame from every new angle, with its camera position and LiDAR depth, guided by a coverage map across three heights, then flip for the underside — made for Gaussian splat reconstruction. Object Capture: Apple's guided photo capture for photogrammetry on a Mac. Scans are in the Files app, ready to AirDrop.

versions.localizedDescription: Orbit capture: move around the object like you're filming; 150+ sharp 4K frames per side with camera positions and LiDAR depth, a coverage map over three heights, then flip for the underside. Built for Gaussian splat scans.
First build: guided coverage, live lighting checks, LiDAR scale.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan3D uses the camera and LiDAR to measure the object and build a 3D model with real-world millimetre scale.

versions.localizedDescription: Claude Code on the phone is now a conversation you scroll like Messages, read from Claude Code's log; nothing is sent to it, so the computer's screen stays put
Stops the computer's screen scrolling on its own while Claude Code is open on the phone
Claude Code scrolls on the phone: the whole conversation is read at phone width and scrolls natively, with its prompt pinned and no more haptic ticks

The pane takes the phone's width while you look at it, so the agent lays out for the phone. Its history scrolls on the phone, smoothly, holds its place while new output arrives, and keeps the prompt pinned at the bottom.
Tapping an agent on another Herdr machine brings it forward

apps.name: Vispr
apps.subtitle: Watch and talk to your agents
apps.localizedDescription: Connects to your computer by SSH, over Tailscale or your home network, to watch your Herdr agents, read their terminals and hold Talk to speak to them. On iPad, agents sit in a sidebar and can be pinned to a grid.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vispr listens while you hold Talk, to type what you say into your agent.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: When your computer's speech server isn't reachable, Vispr can turn speech into text on this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vispr connects to your computer over your home network by SSH.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Vispr can ask for Face ID before it uses your SSH key.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vispr scans the pairing code your computer shows, to find it and let this device in.
